- **Liquid glass AutoSync notifications.** AutoSync's messages now appear as a frosted glass bubble at the bottom of the player. It flows gently while AutoSync works, melts away when the subtitles are synced, or opens into a short explanation when they can't be. On by default; switch back to plain toasts under Nuvio Reshaped › Subtitle AutoSync › Bubble notifications.
- **Seek buffer reads further ahead (Android, ExoPlayer).** The Seek buffer setting now loads what comes next into a temporary file of the chosen size, not just ExoPlayer's memory buffer, so jumps anywhere inside it play instantly. It uses the player's single connection, keeps nothing you have already watched, and the file is deleted when playback ends. The seek bar's buffered mark shows how far it reaches.
- **Smaller fixes.** "Match streams to connection" measures your speed correctly with the larger seek buffer on.
